Velocity-quadrature bias has a separate doubling probe. The independent reference is a derived linear continuum IVP, not a second nonlinear Vlasov engine. Late two-stream behavior is diagnostic; no saturation-value gate. Even-grid Nyquist charge is separately reported rather than included in a full-spectrum Gauss claim. Four-shift Student-t intervals are nominal conditional summaries; neither coverage of the exact rate nor total error is established.
